theme_strategy: 4-Theme Semantic System (Dark Native, Light, High-Contrast Light, High-Contrast Dark)
icon_system: Lucide (lucide-react) ONLY. No emoji characters or emoji icons anywhere.

rules: Headings use Outfit/Manrope with tight tracking (tracking-tight).
Body text uses IBM Plex Sans for legibility in dense tables and metadata lists.
All IDs, entity keys, Cypher queries, graph stats, timestamps, and citations MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Overlines and badges use text-[11px] uppercase JetBrains Mono with tracking-[0.15em].
NO Inter, NO Roboto, NO Space Grotesk for headings.

Derived.label: Derived
Derived.description: Synthesized from multiple source nodes via logic pipeline.

Inferred.label: Inferred
Inferred.description: Probabilistic AI recommendation or statistical match.

Ambiguous.label: Ambiguous
Ambiguous.description: Conflicting evidence or multiple active candidate states.

Human-confirmed.label: Human-Confirmed
Human-confirmed.description: Audited and signed off by human domain expert.

surface_and_elevation.philosophy: Flat tactical minimalism. No muddy drop shadows, no soft glass orbs, no violet marketing gradients. Depth is created via 1px crisp borders and subtle 4-step background gray scaling.
surface_and_elevation.borders: 1px solid var(--border-subtle) with hover transitions to var(--border-strong)

app_shell.left_rail: Collapsed/Expanded rail, <=7 primary groups (Overview, Ask, Graph Explorer, Entity 360, Schema, Ingestion, Settings) with crisp Lucide icons and active indicator line.
app_shell.top_bar: Tenant/Workspace dropdown switcher + Backend Status Chip (Health/Latency) + Global Command Palette trigger (Cmd+K) + Quick Search + Theme Switcher.
app_shell.right_inspector: Sliding drawer / collapsible inspector panel for selected nodes, evidence snippets, or detail cards.
app_shell.bottom_dock: Activity/Jobs dock showing streaming background executions, graph indexing status, and telemetry streams.

SCR-001_auth_tenant.style: Clean dual-panel authentication & tenant selector. Left side: telemetry health matrix visualizer; Right side: login form & workspace/tenant selection grid.

SCR-003_overview.style: High-density dashboard with 3D Graph Health metrics (Coverage, Consistency, Audit Readiness), graph statistic tiles, persona-aware quick start cards, and live audit ledger stream.

SCR-004_ask.style: Evidence-first natural language query composer. Live streaming response container with Answer Mode Badges (Deterministic, Narrated, Exploratory, Report, Simulated, Abstained), Boundary Badge ('Local Only'), hoverable citation tooltips, and Cypher/SPARQL preview modal.

SCR-005_graph_explorer.style: Full-bleed WebGL node-link graph container framed by receding dark control bars. Lens switcher (Fact Class, Risk, Provenance, Community), interactive legend for fact-classes, node density filter, and quick inspector trigger.

SCR-006_entity_360.style: Structured detail view with tabbed navigation: Overview, Relationships (interactive sub-graph), Provenance/Evidence timeline, Impact Analysis matrix, and Cypher/Code payload.

rules: Use explicit transitions: transition-colors, transition-opacity, transition-transform.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by falling back to instant state changes.

testing_convention.rule: Every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, dropdown items, graph nodes, badges) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case role-based format.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with 1px border hierarchy and background step scaling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Preserve human reading flow.
Use modern sharp button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the data tool style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯) for icons. Use Lucide icons only.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing inside containers (p-4 or p-6) to prevent text collision with borders.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
